title.narrative: Improvement of the legal framework in the field of tangible cultural heritage of Uzbekistan

description.narrative: The special status of cultural heritage objects as a unique value of the people of Uzbekistan and an integral part of the world cultural heritage requires a comprehensive and integrated approach to the legal regulation of relations concerning their protection, management, administration and preservation. Current legislation seems powerless to resolve a number of fundamental issues related to the functioning of certain objects of cultural heritage and their status at the regional legal level (for example, problems of coordination of the actions of numerous specialized agencies, correlation of private interests and their public burdens with respect to preservation and use of historical and cultural monuments, etc.). Thus, it is obvious that in order to effectively implement the existing regulatory framework in the field of cultural heritage it is required to make certain changes in the regulatory framework that correspond to the actual situation.
